title: Coefficient transport of the Roos complex with both coordinates
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite and U a scheme. Assume the published scalar transport H=pbcIntegralTransportModules U l E is an equivalence. There is a natural isomorphism gamma from the ordinary integral Roos functor followed by H on complexes to H applied termwise followed by the native completed-coefficient Roos functor. For every native tower C, ordinary integral tower D, tower isomorphism t:C ≅ D followed by H, and complex isomorphism z:H(Roos D) ≅ Roos C whose forward map is gamma_D followed by Roos(t inverse), both product-projection coordinates of PbcIntegralRoosTransportCoordinates U l E C D t z hold. These functors and coordinates are those of [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data].

proof.text: Form scalarRoosMap for the additive coefficient equivalence; preservation of countable products and the normalized pod-reindexing comparison make every component invertible. Naturality of scalarRoosMap makes these components a natural isomorphism. Its two projection formulas composed with the coordinate formulas for Roos of t inverse give the two required transport coordinates. Substitute the assumed forward map formula for z. This works for every C, D and t, without a flatness or boundedness assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_integral_coefficient_roos_coordinates
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (U : Scheme.{u})
    [(pbcIntegralTransportModules U l E).IsEquivalence] :
    ∃ γ : integralOperationsRoosFunctor (A := integralTowerModules l E U) ⋙
          pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E ≅
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E) ⋙
          integralOperationsRoosFunctor
            (A := pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E))),
      ∀ (C : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex
          (pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) ℤ)
        (D : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E U) ℤ)
        (t : C ≅ D ⋙ pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E)
        (z : (pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E).obj (integralOperationsRoos D) ≅
          integralOperationsRoos C),
        z.hom = γ.hom.app D ≫ integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map t.inv →
          PbcIntegralRoosTransportCoordinates U l E C D t z
